newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel still looking for local buyers.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel still looking for local buyers.

text.p: European jet fuel endured a lacklustre day on Tuesday with premiums looking scrappy and outrights saved only by firmer gas oil futures.
April IPE gas oil last traded $1.50 a tonne stronger at $172.25.
Jet barge premiums in NWE were around April IPE +$18 fob ARA while cargoes were pegged around April IPE +$21 cif NWE.
Buying interest in NWE was quiet with the Med able to attract marginally more business.
"It's not local demand that is supporting the market, it's from outside," said one trader referring to South American and African buying requirements.
EC spec material was seen unchanged at around fob high quotes +$8-9.00 with Libyian talked around fob high quotes +$5.
